premise: At sunset the day's Butterfly and the night's Firefly meet beside Flower, each shows the other her time, and Flower closes up for the night keeping their meeting place.
inspiration: The folk pairing of the Sun and the Moon, who never meet, turned: they do meet, at sunset, and trade their worlds.
lesson: Friends who are different can share their worlds.

en-US.title: Butterfly Meets Firefly
en-US.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} {butterfly:enter} Butterfly loved the daytime: warm light, bright colours, flowers everywhere. {butterfly:face sad} [sighs] But every evening, just as it turned golden, it was time for bed. {canvas:sunset 0.8 30s} One evening she stayed a little longer, beside {flower:enter} Flower {flower:pulse}. {butterfly:live} She closed her wings to rest… and a tiny light came flying up! Open went her wings, flutter, flutter. {butterfly:face surprised} [gasps] Hello, said the light. It was {firefly:enter} Firefly! {firefly:face happy} I'm just waking up. What's the day like? {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:sparkle} Butterfly told her about the colours, and the bees, and the big blue sky. [curious] And what's the night like? {canvas:night 0.6 24s} {sfx:crickets} {firefly:live} Firefly glowed brighter and brighter, like a little lantern… blink, blink. Like this! And she told about the moon, and the stars, and the crickets. {firefly:hearts} {butterfly:hearts} [happily] Let's meet here every sunset! said Butterfly. {flower:face happy} Flower smiled. And as the moon rose, {flower:live hold} she folded her petals into a bud, and kept their place till tomorrow.

es-ES.title: Mariposa conoce a Luciérnaga
es-ES.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} A {butterfly:enter} Mariposa le encantaba el día: luz calentita, colores brillantes, flores por todas partes. {butterfly:face sad} [sighs] Pero cada tarde, cuando todo se ponía dorado, llegaba la hora de dormir. {canvas:sunset 0.8 30s} Una tarde, se quedó un poquito más, junto a {flower:enter} Flor {flower:pulse}. {butterfly:live} Juntó las alas para descansar… ¡y llegó volando una lucecita! Se le abrieron las alas, flap, flap. {butterfly:face surprised} [gasps] Hola, dijo la luz. ¡Era {firefly:enter} Luciérnaga! {firefly:face happy} Me acabo de despertar. ¿Cómo es el día? {butterfly:face happy} {butterfly:sparkle} Mariposa le habló de los colores, y de las abejas, y del cielo azul. [curious] ¿Y cómo es la noche? {canvas:night 0.6 24s} {sfx:crickets} {firefly:live} Luciérnaga brilló más y más, como un farolillo… blinc, blinc. ¡Así! Y le habló de la luna, y de las estrellas, y de los grillos. {firefly:hearts} {butterfly:hearts} [happily] ¡Vamos a vernos aquí cada atardecer!, dijo Mariposa. {flower:face happy} Flor sonrió. Y mientras salía la luna, {flower:live hold} plegó sus pétalos en un capullo, y les guardó el sitio.

crickets.prompt: the first soft crickets of a summer evening
